variants.specifics: Brackenford: Garrick at the shut north gate, then the gate open again.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Brave enough to walk right up to my gate. But that won't get you through it! Now move along!

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: I don't see many carts on this road lately.

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: All honest travelers may pass north again!

variants.specifics: Krennack: Stobb, the guard at the lift lever by the Pit Office, before and after the Great Lift is retaken.

first.speaker: Stobb
first.text: Where have you been? The Foreman has been asking for you all morning! You'd best get over to the Pit Office if you ever want to see the Great Lift running again. The Ogres won't leave by themselves.

again.speaker: Stobb
again.text: Get away from that lift lever, lad! Unless you WANT to go down the hard way!

later.speaker: Stobb
later.text: Hey, you should get a helmet before you go back down the Great Lift.

variants.specifics: Skell: Warden Brodd keeps the village lockup, where Tolly sits again.

first.speaker: Warden Brodd
first.text: Hold it right there, stranger! Mother Hesk says you tracked swamp mud all through her shop and her floor testifies to it! Come on. I've got a damp, drafty cell waiting just for you! Will you come quietly, stranger?

again.speaker: Warden Brodd
again.text: Back in your cell, Tolly! Have a pleasant nap!

later.speaker: Warden Brodd
later.text: You can tell it to Mayor Pellum yourself... unless you'd like to share Tolly's cell.

variants.specifics: Varrok: Bolk guards the east postern, barred until Warden Grisholm gives the player leave to cross to the Stone Bridge.

first.speaker: Bolk
first.text: Absolutely not! Off with you, ruffian!

later.speaker: Bolk
later.text:
Stop where you are, stranger! Warden Grisholm says you have leave to pass, and his seal proves it.

Go on! I've unbarred the gate and oiled the hinges just for you.

Will you be back by nightfall, stranger?

variants.specifics: Kesk: Dorvic at the causeway gate of Kesk, with his fellow guard Tull.

first.speaker: Dorvic
first.text: Tull, here is one more brave soul who wishes to go swimming with Skarn's dead men!

again.speaker: Dorvic
again.text: Fine. Off you go. Mind the water.

later.speaker: Dorvic
later.text: You ran from a dead fisherman!? You're useless! Now back to the gate! You make me ill!

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Brusk keeps the College gate while Malgrin's Ogres hold the fen road.

first.speaker: Brusk
first.text: Wanna get yourself turned into a toad?

again.speaker: Brusk
again.text: We must hold this gate and keep those Ogres out of the College tonight!

later.speaker: Brusk
later.text: I hope the Ogres stay in their fen.

variants.specifics: Ulmgard: Hask at the Low Gate of Ulmgard, pointing newcomers up to Warden Galmor; later the Upper Gate is open.

first.speaker: Hask
first.text: I thought you lowlanders could take a little cold. Try stamping your feet.

again.speaker: Hask
again.text: Hurry! Warden Galmor is expecting you up in his hall at the top of the keep. There's a stair behind the stables that will lead you straight to him.

later.speaker: Hask
later.text: Welcome back to Ulmgard. The Upper Gate is open to you now.

variants.specifics: Kalgarr: Tibbet, a guard at the town gate who likes the look of the player.

again.speaker: Tibbet
again.text: My, my! You're a good deal handsomer than the usual smiths! Come find me at the gate when you're not off fighting demons.

variants.specifics: Torvel: Brask keeps the north gate of Torvel, locked by Mayor Dremmel while Skarn's bandits hold Varga Tower.

first.speaker: Brask
first.text: I'm told the bandits up at Varga Tower lately robbed a tinker of his own trousers. Nasty business all over these days.

again.speaker: Brask
again.text: You'll find Mayor Dremmel in the Toll House. He has the key to this gate.

later.speaker: Brask
later.text: Move aside! You were meant to stop Skarn's men, you lout!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Durnhal: Wendt at the north gate of Durnhal, shut by Mayor Quillon while Ugrash's Ogres hold the Stone Granary.

first.speaker: Wendt
first.text: You're awful scrawny for an Ogre-fighter. Hah, hah, hah...!

again.speaker: Wendt
again.text: Hey! Nobody goes out this gate!

later.speaker: Wendt
later.text: The north gate is open now, but you should go on to Mayor Quillon at the Town Hall. Much obliged for the help, brave Wanderer!
